source: G1323 (#725): Ice Nubbin spots measured on players' 2012 pictures (some posted in 2013) of five Nottis streets (reference only, no pixels kept). No full-street snap covers Nottis, so each picture (a window of the street, 1:1 in the game but for Lotha Harte at 1/1.38 and Slappao Kalt at 1/1.68) was registered on the street's own art as the game draws it (the street-sized layers rendered at 1:1 by public/js/street-render.js, normalized cross-correlation in grey, coarse at 1/4 then at full size: scores 0.68-0.94, each checked by eye on an overlay), and our CC0 Ice Nubbin art (assets/sprites/resources/ice-knob-knob1-4.webp, every frame) matched in a window around each nubbin seen by eye, masked normalized cross-correlation as tools/snap-placements/nodes.py does: scores 0.78-0.96 (Dokk Rokk's seven on one picture and three of them again on another agree within 1 px). Two were read by eye, each half hidden (marked): Lotha Harte's 3506 behind a tree in front, Dokk Rokk's 1415 on its second picture behind the Scraper at work. Each spot is [x, y, knob]: the frame cell's bottom centre in street px (0, 0 = the street's top left) and the variant the picture shows (knob<n>). Every one sits on a snow skirt (snow_skirt_01a/b/c) of the layer behind the avatars, its bottom 31 to 204 px over the floor in front (median 92): js/ice-nubbin-walls.js places the rest by that habit. Do not edit by hand without the pictures.
